ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a single-loop AC circuit, with an RMS voltage source labeled 20∠0° V on the left; a source internal impedance connected in series at the top, labeled Z_s = (1+2j) Ω; and a load impedance on the right, labeled Z_L = (7+4j) Ω. Reasoning: The source internal impedance and the load impedance are in series, so the total impedance is Z_total = Z_s + Z_L = (1+2j) + (7+4j) = (8+6j) Ω. Its magnitude is |Z_total| = sqrt(8^2 + 6^2) = 10 Ω. The source RMS voltage is 20 V, so the loop RMS current magnitude is |I| = 20/10 = 2 A. The reactive part of the load is X_L = +4 Ω, so the reactive power consumed by the load is Q_L = |I|^2 X_L = 2^2 × 4 = 16 VAR.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the source, Z_s, and Z_L are connected in one loop, with Z_L being the right-side element whose reactive power is requested. From the text, take V_s=20∠0° V RMS, Z_s=1+2jΩ, and Z_L=7+4jΩ. Compute the load voltage by voltage division: V_L=20(7+4j)/(8+6j). method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个单回路交流电路，左侧为电压源，标注为 20∠0° V；上方串联一个内部阻抗，标注为 Z_s=(1+2j)Ω；右侧为负载元件，标注为 Z_L=(7+4j)Ω。题目要求的是右侧负载 Z_L 消耗的无功功率。推理：采用 RMS 相量。总阻抗为 Z_total=Z_s+Z_L=(1+2j)+(7+4j)=8+6j Ω。回路电流 I=V_s/Z_total=20/(8+6j)=20(8-6j)/(8^2+6^2)=1.6-1.2j A，因此 |I|^2=1.6^2+(-1.2)^2=4。负载复功率 S_L=|I|^2 Z_L=4(7+4j)=28+16j VA。无功功率为复功率虚部，所以 Q_L=16 VAR。
